module "B_DynamicIf.dss"

  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="x") : float @L12:C9
  %2 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.5), ParameterName="Threshold", SortPriority=0) : float @L6:C1 "Threshold"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(1, 0, 0)) : float3 @L14:C18 "Colour"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0, 0, 1)) : float3 @L18:C18 "Colour"
  %5 = Compare(%1, %2, %3, %4, %4) : float3 @L12:C5
  %6 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%5) @L8:C1
  sink %6
